definitions.explanation: The sixth month of the year. Known as the rainy season (梅雨, tsuyu) in most of Japan.

examples.english: There's a lot of rain in June.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}く→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{六月|ろくがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まります→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The rainy season starts in June.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{終|お}わり→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦ごろ→ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{晴|は}れ→晴れ：02936_hare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Around the end of June, sunny days finally become more frequent.

examples.japanese: {六月|ろくがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦とき→とき：03094_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていった→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: When going out in June, you'd better bring an umbrella.

notes:
{六月|ろくがつ} is June, the sixth month of the year.

PATTERN:
Japanese months use number + ⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧: ⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧, ⟦{二月|にがつ}→二月：00657_nigatsu⟧, etc.

CULTURAL NOTES:
- Most of Japan (except Hokkaido) experiences ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season) in June
- Despite the rain, "June bride" (⟦ジューンブライド→ジューンブライド：noentry⟧) weddings are popular due to Western influence
- ⟦{衣替|ころもが}え→衣替え：07709_koromogae⟧ (seasonal clothing change) traditionally happens June 1st

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {六月|ろくがつ}⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧: mid-June
- {六月|ろくがつ}⟦{上旬|じょうじゅん}→上旬：17767_joujun⟧: early June
- {六月|ろくがつ}⟦{下旬|げじゅん}→下旬：00062_gejun⟧: late June

RELATED:
- ⟦{梅雨入|つゆい}り→梅雨入り：08337_tsuyuiri⟧: start of rainy season
- ⟦{梅雨明|つゆあ}け→梅雨明け：08338_tsuyuake⟧: end of rainy season
